study_purpose.text: The study aims to investigate how vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy affects the response of bone to vibration in children.

who_may_join.text: Children whose mothers participated in the Maternal Vitamin D Osteoporosis Study (MAVIDOS) in Sheffield are eligible for this study.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will undergo various tests and procedures, including bone mineral density tests, MRI/CT scans, and blood tests to measure vitamin D, calcium, phosphorus, and PTH levels.

risks_or_burdens.text: There are no specific risks or burdens mentioned in the provided evidence.

time_commitment.text: The study length is 2 years after completing radiation therapy, with additional follow-ups for up to 5 years.
